papers.title: A Topology-Aware Quantum-Classical Framework for Multi-Target Active Debris Removal using Gaussian Boson Sampling
papers.summary: The continued growth of orbital debris threatens the safety and sustainability of near-Earth space, making Active Debris Removal (ADR) an important mitigation strategy. Selecting $k$ targets from $N$ candidates yields a combinatorial search space of size $\binom{N}{k}$, making joint target selection and mission sequencing computationally demanding. We present a topology-aware quantum-classical framework integrating orbital mechanics, weighted orbital-transfer graphs, Gaussian Boson Sampling (GBS), and multi-objective evolutionary optimization. Seven target-prioritization strategies represent physical consequence, orbital persistence, conjunction risk, network centrality, community structure, inferred source families, and random selection. GBS generates candidate target subsets from the weighted graph, which are then evaluated using PyGMO-based evolutionary optimization to identify servicing sequences that jointly minimize total velocity increment ($\Delta v$) and mission duration, accounting for modeled timing, propulsion, and mass feasibility. We evaluate the framework across three benchmark environments, SOCRATES Minefield, Collision Cloud, and Random, with candidate-pool sizes $N\in\{15,18,22,25\}$ and target cardinalities $k\in\{3,5\}$. The experiments characterize how benchmark topology, prioritization strategy, and problem scale relate to sampling behavior and downstream mission performance. By separating candidate-subset generation from detailed trajectory optimization, the framework offers a topology-aware approach to focusing computational effort on a limited set of candidate ADR missions.

papers.title: Closed-form Optimal Solutions for Propulsive-Differential Drag Control of Spacecraft Swarms
papers.summary: This paper presents a novel optimal control approach for Distributed Space Systems (DSS) to minimize the total delta-v cost for large, time-constrained reconfigurations. Reconfiguration cost is decreased by blending differential drag and propulsive control within the same control window. By parameterizing the problem with Relative Orbital Elements (ROE) and leveraging reachable set theory, a maneuver planning methodology is derived to produce provably-optimal, full roto-translational control solutions in closed-form, such that they can be implemented on hardware-limited spacecraft.

papers.title: Closed-form Optimal Propulsive-Differential Drag Control for Large Reconfigurations of Spacecraft Swarms
papers.summary: Distributed Space Systems offer unique capabilities but have significant hardware limitations on computational processing and fuel when employing small satellites. These constraints drive interest in deterministic maneuver planning that incorporates orbital perturbations to improve final state accuracy and decrease reconfiguration delta-v cost. This paper proposes a novel closed-form, provably optimal framework to generate complete roto-translational solutions for propulsive-differential drag control of multiple satellites. The approach leverages relative orbit elements and reachable set theory to characterize all control with a single methodology that can be readily generalized to generic impulsive-continuous control. The algorithm is robust to large reconfigurations and extended control windows where differential drag is most effective.

papers.title: Autoregressive Physics-Informed Neural Operator Surrogates and Joint 4-D Seismic-Production Bayesian History Matching
papers.summary: We present a surrogate-accelerated Bayesian history-matching framework, demonstrated on a realistic synthetic model ($N=100{,}188$ cells). The forward map $\mathcal{G}$ is replaced by a Fourier neural operator $\mathcal{G}_\theta$ trained in a closed loop, $\hat{x}_{n+1}=\mathcal{G}_\theta(u,\hat{x}_n)$, with the discrete black-oil residual $R(x_{n+1},x_n)$ as a physics-informed neural operator (PINO) penalty, truncated backpropagation and noise injection. We assimilate production data and 4-D seismic using adaptive regularised ensemble Kalman inversion (aREKI), and synthesise $\Delta V_p$ inside the rollout via a closed-form Gassmann transform of the surrogate, under a two-stage schedule (aREKI on production, then an ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation, ES-MDA, on both). To temper the ill-posedness, we invert $(\log K,\phi)$ not in $\mathbb{R}^{2N}$, where $N_e\ll 2N$ leaves a rank-deficient covariance and a null space the data never inform, but on a chart $u=\Psi(\tilde m)$, $\tilde m\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$, $d\ll 2N$, given by a Parseval-exact truncated cosine transform or a variational auto-encoder decoder. The ensemble then spans its own search space; the directions the data cannot constrain are cut to those the chart can express, and every member decodes to a geologically plausible field. For the rollout we prove an exposure bound $W_1\le\sum_j L^{\,n-1-j}\mathbb{E}e_j$, a physics-penalty contraction $\|D_x\mathcal{G}_\theta\|\le\alpha<1$ under a small residual defect, and an $\mathcal{O}(\rho^K)$ truncation bias. A Loewner-order inequality $\mathcal{I}_p\preceq\mathcal{I}_p+\mathcal{I}_s$ explains why joint assimilation is no less informative. On held-out data, $\mathcal{G}_\theta$ attains $R^2>0.999$ on pressure and saturation and rolls out in $0.579$ s, a $\sim2500\times$ speed-up, bringing an $N_e=190$-member, $N_a=10$-iteration joint inversion within one GPU-hour.
papers.title_ja: 自己回帰型物理情報ニューラルオペレータサロゲートと、4次元地震データと生産データの統合ベイズ履歴マッチング

papers.title: End-to-End Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning for Physics-Informed Optimization
papers.summary: Optimizing high-dimensional physical systems under expensive evaluations and complex constraints is a central challenge in science and engineering. In offline model-based optimization (MBO), methods must improve designs using only a fixed dataset and no test-time access to the true objective. However, existing methods typically suffer from conservatism, unconstrained surrogate exploitation, or function as static inference-time samplers that cannot refine candidates against precise physical objectives. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Diffusion Conditioning (D2C) for offline MBO, which leverages the fact that deterministic sampling makes the reverse denoising chain differentiable with respect to the conditioning signal. D2C turns a frozen conditional diffusion model into an end-to-end gradient-based optimizer by directly optimizing conditioning variables at test time via gradients from frozen surrogate objectives and physics-informed penalties backpropagated through the reverse chain. We implement this idea in a composed proposer-evaluator framework and evaluate it on laser pulse optimization for inertial confinement fusion, sustainable data-center workload scheduling, and four Design-Bench tasks. Our method achieves the strongest results on the two real-world tasks and the best average rank across four Design-Bench tasks.
papers.title_ja: 物理情報最適化のためのエンドツーエンド微分可能拡散条件付け

papers.title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
papers.summary: Physics-informed machine learning has become a major direction in predictive modeling of fluid dynamics, combining governing physics with learned representations. Yet prevailing formulations neither guarantee that small PDE-residual losses imply small solution errors nor scale effectively with increasing problem size. Here we present the neural basis method (NBM) as a new approach for Navier--Stokes dynamics. NBM is built on a ``representation-then-projection'' principle: fixed neural bases define the representation space, while projection of the governing equations determines the expansion coefficients. The same bases define common coordinates for the parametric solution manifold, recasting operator learning as a parameter-to-coefficient mapping and enabling scalability by removing explicit spatial dependence. For incompressible flow, NBM yields a velocity-only formulation whose residual provides an a posteriori velocity-error estimate, establishing a certified, data-free training objective for coefficient learning. Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrate the accuracy, efficiency, generalization, and scalability of NBM, with substantial improvements over baselines.
papers.title_ja: ニューラルベース法によるナビエ・ストークス方程式の解法と学習
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報機械学習（PINN）の限界を克服するため、固定されたニューラルベースと支配方程式の射影を用いた「ニューラルベース法（NBM）」を提案する。この手法は、パラメトリックな解の多様体を共通座標系で表現し、空間依存性を除去することでスケーラビリティを向上させる。非圧縮流では、速度のみを用いた定式化により、残差から速度誤差の事後評価が可能となり、データフリーかつ保証された学習目標を実現する。理論的解析と数値実験により、既存手法に対する精度・効率・汎化性能の大幅な改善が示されている。

papers.title: CoPiT: A conditional Position-induced Transformer for aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes
papers.summary: High-fidelity Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) simulations remain a standard tool for aerodynamic analysis, yet each solve on an unstructured mesh is computationally expensive, making many-query tasks such as design exploration, optimization, and multi-condition evaluation costly. Neural operators provide mesh-flexible surrogates for mapping geometry and operating conditions to flow fields; however, in many existing architectures, global parameters such as the freestream state and design variables are concatenated with pointwise inputs, leaving their influence on intermediate features implicit. This paper proposes CoPiT, a \textbf{Co}nditional \textbf{P}osition-induced \textbf{T}ransformer that builds on the Position-induced Transformer (PiT) as its geometric backbone and injects a global condition vector through multi-stage feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), thereby making parametric modulation explicit while preserving geometry-based attention weights. The model is evaluated on two-dimensional AirfRANS airfoil fields, including scarce-data and extrapolation regimes, and on three-dimensional BlendedNet++ blended-wing-body surfaces. On the AirfRANS full-data test set, CoPiT reduces surface and volume losses by approximately 54\% and 24\% relative to Transolver, respectively, and achieves the lowest overall normalized test MSE among the compared baselines on BlendedNet++. Matched ablations show that FiLM conditioning generally improves upon input concatenation, while the preferred placement is task-dependent. CoPiT thus provides a practical operator-learning surrogate for parametric aerodynamics on unstructured meshes.
papers.title_ja: CoPiT: 非構造メッシュにおける気流場予測のための条件付き位置誘導型Transformer

papers.title: Acquisition for Spherical-Linear Bayesian Optimization on the Cube
papers.summary: Recent work demonstrated that executing Bayesian Optimization (BO) using simply a linear surrogate with a clever transformation is enough to approximate the performance of the standard Gaussian-Process (GP) based version on high-dimensional test functions. When the decision region is a sphere, this strategy admits rapid exact acquisition. However, it is the unit cube we encounter most often in the BO literature, and in this setting a standard approach, namely a multi-start quasi-Newton method, is employed for solving the acquisition subproblem. In this article, we will discuss a series of results, both positive and negative, regarding the complexity of global resolution of various acquisition subproblems over the unit cube. On the basis of this discussion, we will propose a new acquisition function which is globally optimizable using significantly less execution time than the incumbent approach while maintaining or improving performance. The resulting method is competitive with GP-based BO in terms of accuracy per evaluation, and is superior in terms of accuracy per walltime on black-boxes of low to moderate computational intensity.
papers.title_ja: 立方体上の球線形ベイズ最適化のための獲得関数

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.summary: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) global rank allocation, where uncalibrated error proxies fail to capture complex error propagation, and (ii) decomposition quality, where Fisher-based estimators suffer from severe rank collapse. In this work, we address these limitations by introducing Layer-wise Error Modeling Search (LEMS) and KFAC-SVD. LEMS advances rank allocation by introducing a layer-wise error surrogate that integrates local and global layer importance alongside a propagation bias, enabling effective global rank allocation via an ILP formulation. KFAC-SVD improves decomposition quality by utilizing token-wise statistics, mitigating the rank deficiency observed in prior Fisher-based SVD approaches. Across Mistral, Qwen3, and Llama 3 model families, we show that LEMS consistently outperforms existing search strategies, delivering significant zero-shot accuracy gains of up to 4.8 p.p. that generalize to model sizes of 70B parameters, while KFAC-SVD achieves an average perplexity improvement of 15%. Project page and code: https://lems-svd.github.io

papers.title: Classical, Machine Learning, and Hybrid Solvers for Partial Differential Equations: An Evidence-Weighted Review and Decision Framework
papers.summary: Machine learning for partial differential equations raises a practical question: when are classical, learned, or hybrid solvers justified? This survey compares the three families in a decision framework organized by data availability, query volume, and certification needs. An amortization law, tested on parametric Darcy flow, shows that surrogates trained on solver-generated data break even only after many queries, beyond thirty thousand for errors below one percent. An evidence ladder, a benchmark reanalysis, and three case studies show that claims of speedup and generalization carry the weakest evidence. Solver choice should follow regime, query volume, and evidence quality, not method novelty.
papers.title_ja: 偏微分方程式のための古典的・機械学習・ハイブリッドソルバ：証拠重み付きレビューと意思決定フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、偏微分方程式（PDE）の求解において古典的手法、機械学習ベースのサロゲートモデル、およびハイブリッド手法のいずれが適しているかを判断するためのフレームワークを提案する。データ量やクエリ頻度、認証要件に基づいた意思決定基準を提示し、特にパラメトリックダルシー流を用いた検証により、サロゲートモデルがコスト対効果で優位になるのはクエリ数が3万回を超えた場合のみであることを示した。また、既存の高速化や汎化性能に関する主張は証拠が最も弱いことを指摘し、手法の新しさではなく、利用シーンと証拠の質に基づいた選択を推奨している。

papers.title: ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
papers.summary: State inference and parameter learning for nonlinear filters is a core computation for scientific machine learning with varied applications in engineering and neuroscience. The unnormalized filtering distribution is governed by the Zakai equation, a stochastic partial differential equation (SPDE) that combines the forward Kolmogorov operator (known as the Fokker-Planck equation) with observed likelihood updates. Although solving these high-dimensional SPDEs is often impossible analytically and intractable numerically, advances in operator learning and physics-informed machine learning have made it feasible. Harnessing these advances, we introduce the Zakai Equation Neural Operator (ZENO), a model that optimizes a neural operator against a Zakai Equation based physics-informed loss to approximate the exact unnormalized filtering distribution for latent stochastic dynamical systems. We use this ZENO-inferred posterior distribution in an expectation-maximization (EM) framework to perform parameter learning and state inference. We demonstrate ZENO's ability to accurately infer the posterior distribution and learn its corresponding SDE parameters in three simulated stochastic dynamical systems (Double-Well bistable system, Van Der Pol (VDP) oscillator, and Lorenz system) and compare its performance against established methods for latent SDE inference and learning. We show that ZENO recovers previously observed limit cycles representing forward and backward locomotion from a whole-brain imaging dataset of immobilized \textit{C. elegans} nematodes. ZENO is a novel approach to the problem of nonlinear filtering and dynamical inference through the lens of partial differential equations and operator theory.
papers.title_ja: ZENO: Zakai方程式ニューラルオペレータによる非線形フィルタリング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、非線形確率微分方程式（SDE）のフィルタリング問題を、Zakai方程式に基づく物理情報損失関数で最適化されたニューラルオペレータ（ZENO）を用いて解決する手法を提案する。このモデルは、潜在変数の非正規化フィルタリング分布を高精度に近似し、EMアルゴリズムと組み合わせてパラメータ推定と状態推定を行う。Double-Well系、Van Der Pol振動子、Lorenz系などのシミュレーションおよびC. elegansの脳イメージングデータにおいて、既存手法と比較して優れた性能を示した。

papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
papers.summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.
papers.title_ja: 投機的拡散は二つのトレードオフの物語
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、拡散型大規模言語モデル（dLLM）における推論高速化手法「投機的拡散」の最適化を扱う。従来の自己回帰型LLMとは異なり、dLLMは並列生成により高速だが、拡散ステップ数を減らすことで品質を犠牲にして速度を上げる特性を持つ。本研究では、拡散の努力量（ステップ数）と投機的デコーディングの許容度（検証基準の緩さ）という2つのパラメータを同時に調整し、速度と品質のパーレートフロントを探索した。実験の結果、これらを連動して変化させることで、単一ステップの拡散ドラフトよりも広い範囲で高速かつ高品質な推論が可能になることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化と拡散モデルの効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: Free Lunch for LLMs Confidence: The RL Critic Already Knows
papers.summary: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for trustworthy deployment of large language models (LLMs), but dedicated confidence training stage requires additional data and compute. We ask a fundamental question: what prediction problem does confidence training actually solve? Inspired by prior work on external confidence estimation, we compare self- and external estimators of comparable capacity trained on the same (question, response, correctness) triples. We show that an external model trained solely on a policy's behavioral traces can estimate the policy's confidence as accurately as the policy itself, without accessing the policy's internal representations. This points to a deeper connection with value function learning in reinforcement learning (RL): under a correctness-based outcome, we prove that confidence estimation and critic training are equivalent, both predicting the likelihood that a policy's response will be correct from its trajectory. A simple consequence follows: for LLMs trained with value-based RL, the existing critic can be reused as an off-the-shelf confidence estimator with no additional training or data. The policy remains unchanged, so its task performance is preserved, and the critic provides confidence throughout generation, including intermediate reasoning steps. Across math, code, tool calling, and general reasoning spanning a dozen domains, the reused critic is the best confidence estimator on every in-distribution split and the best-calibrated on 14 of 16, without hurting the task performance.
papers.title_ja: LLMの信頼度評価における無料の昼食：RLクリティクはすでに知っている
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の信頼度推定において、強化学習（RL）で訓練されたクリティクモデルをそのまま再利用できることを示した。正解率ベースの成果報酬下では、信頼度推定とクリティクの価値関数学習が数学的に等価であることを証明した。これにより、追加のデータや計算コストなしで、生成過程の中間ステップを含む信頼度を高精度に推定可能となる。数学・コード・ツール呼び出しなど16領域のベンチマークで、タスク性能を維持しつつ最良のキャリブレーション性能を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・RL手法・評価ベンチマークの交差点で高関連

papers.title: Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints
papers.summary: Synthetic rewrites, where a language model rewrites a natural document e.g. into a target style, are now a standard ingredient of pretraining corpora. However, critical aspects of their use remain poorly understood, such as how much compute should be spent rewriting training data and whether a model trained on rewrites can outperform the rewriter. We study these two questions by proposing a rewriting scaling law that predicts loss from model size, training tokens, the fraction of training tokens that are rewrites, and the number of epochs over the natural data, charging the compute spent generating rewrites. We fit this scaling law in two settings. In the compute-limited setting, natural data is plentiful and rewrites come from a third-party rewriter trained with more compute than our largest run. We find that the estimated optimal rewrite fraction increases with compute, from under $10\%$ at $3\times10^{18}$ FLOPs to $32\%$ at $10^{22}$ FLOPs. Our scaling forecast extrapolates $33\times$ in FLOPs to train a 22B-parameter model, whose final loss is within $1.1\%$ of our prediction. This model achieves a better BPB than its rewriter on several web domains at one-tenth the rewriter's training compute. In the data-limited setting, we assume we only have a fixed seed set of natural data and that our rewriter is a model of the same size as the target, pretrained on that seed set. Again, we find the optimal rewrite fraction increases with the compute budget. We also demonstrate that a model trained on rewrites of its own pretraining data, generated by a rewriter of the same size, beats the best run on natural data alone at every model size up to 3B. Our results show that synthetic rewriting can be studied through the scaling law lens: that optimal methodological choices are predictable and scaling does not necessarily break down beyond the rewriter's capabilities.
papers.title_ja: 計算量とデータ制約下における合成データのためのスケーリング則の再構築
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの事前学習において合成データ（書き換えデータ）の活用方法をスケーリング則の観点から定式化し、最適な書き換え比率を予測するモデルを提案する。計算量制限下では、計算資源の増加に伴い最適な書き換え比率が上昇し、書き換えモデルより少ない計算量で同等以上の性能を発揮できることを示した。データ制限下では、同じサイズの書き換えモデルを用いた自己生成データが、自然データのみでの学習を上回ることを確認した。これにより、合成データ利用の限界や最適化手法が予測可能であることが明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化・スケーリング則・合成データ設計の核心を扱うため

papers.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
papers.summary: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. And choosing the decisions is the ground-state problem of a higher-order Boltzmann machine whose interactions follow the paths of the tree, the problem class that annealers and quantum optimizers are built to solve. Today these questions are handled apart: each compression method brings its own format and solver, a circuit with fixed weights needs a dedicated constant multiplier for every weight, and discrete solvers reach only narrow subproblems such as rounding. Weight formats have long been moving toward shared decisions, through group scales, shared exponents, microexponents and sparse weights; TWIG takes this trend to its end, and every common format is a shallow TWIG at no extra cost. On five weight matrices of a large language model, a flat tree whose signed power-of-two terms are chosen per weight for circuit cost, with no group scales, needs 9--15\% fewer additions than GPTQ at equal layer error at 3- and 4-bit accuracy on typical matrices, and 20--55\% fewer on matrices with strong outliers.
papers.title_ja: すべての重みは共有された離散決定のパスである
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ニューラルネットワークの重みを木構造の離散決定（符号、2のべき乗シフト、ゼロゲートなど）のパスとして表現するTWIGフレームワークを提案する。この表現により、剪定・量子化・低ランク分解などの圧縮手法を単一のオブジェクト編集として統合し、1つの最適化器で全体を最適化可能にする。さらに、決定の選択を高次ボルツマン機械の基底状態問題として定式化し、アニーラーや量子最適化器との親和性を示す。LLMの重み行列において、GPTQと比較して同等の誤差で9〜15%少ない加算で済むことを実証し、回路コストの削減と量子最適化への橋渡しを実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM量子化・効率化と量子最適化の融合という核心関心に直結

papers.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
papers.summary: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime. These results establish TTME as an effective and computationally efficient alternative to TTT in the evaluated discovery settings.
papers.title_ja: 科学的発見において、テスト時メモリ進化はテスト時学習を上回るか？
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、科学的発見タスクにおける大規模言語モデル（LLM）の効率化手法として、テスト時学習（TTT）の代替案である「テスト時メモリ進化（TTME）」を提案する。TTMEはモデルの重みを更新せず、外部メモリに経験を蒸留して蓄積することで適応を行うプラグアンドプレイ方式である。同一フレームワーク下での比較評価により、TTMEは5つの数学タスクすべてでTTTを上回る性能を示した。さらに、計算コスト（FLOPs）を82.8〜84.6%、実行時間を47.7〜58.4%削減し、計算効率と性能の両面で優位性を証明した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論効率化とエージェント設計の核心を突く手法

papers.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
papers.summary: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later. Experiments with agents based on open-weight models from the Qwen family across open-ended research (GAIA), tool-use workflows (Claw-Eval), and terminal tasks (Terminal-Bench 2.1) show that our method improves overall success rates by 8.9 to 17.0 percentage points and performs competitively with frontier systems. We find that Self-Direction reduces repeated mistakes across future encounters of a task, nearly doubling the reliability of an agent's corrections. Learned lessons also transfer: a handful of adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks without additional training. Ultimately, this self-directed repair transforms everyday mistakes into lasting lessons.
papers.title_ja: 今学んだことを忘れるな：自己主導型修復がエージェントの誤りを永続的な教訓に変える
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMエージェントが失敗から学び、その教訓を永続的に保持する仕組み「Self-Direction」を提案する。タスク失敗時に軌跡を振り返り、軽量な低ランクアダプタ（LoRA）として知識を蒸留・保存することで、コンテキスト競合やフルファインチューニングのコストを回避する。Qwen系モデルを用いたGAIAやTerminal-Benchなどの実験では、成功率が8.9〜17.0ポイント向上し、学習した教訓が新規タスクへも転移することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と効率化（LoRA）の両方に直結する手法

papers.title: CuraLoc: Repository-Level Fault Localization via Planned Code Inspection
papers.summary: A bug report describes what went wrong, but rarely where the code should change. Existing repository-level localization methods often let language models iteratively decide what code to inspect next, requiring repeated model calls and substantial token usage. We investigate whether these inspection decisions can instead be planned before source retrieval. In this research, we introduce CuraLoc, which first selects candidate files and represents their symbols using compact behavioral and structural descriptions. In a single planning decision, the model jointly selects starting symbols, chooses code relationships to inspect from each, and forms hypotheses about likely edits. Deterministic retrieval collects the requested source for a final ranking informed by those hypotheses, concentrating model reasoning on choosing and comparing code rather than directing each retrieval step. We demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach on the SWE-Bench Lite and Verified datasets. On SWE Bench Verified with GPT-5.2, CuraLoc raises Func@1 from LocAgent's 53.8% to 59.3% while using 90.3% fewer recorded tokens, and also outperforms RepoSearcher (56.2%) and Agentless (39.6%) on Func@1. On SWE-bench Lite, CuraLoc achieves a high 83.8% Func@5 accuracy improving on Agentless by more than 15% in relative accuracy. Additionally, CuraLoc supports different model backbones, with strong localization accuracy demonstrated using both GPT-5.2 and GPT-6 Astra. These results provide evidence that repository-level code inspection can be planned effectively without iterative model-controlled navigation.
papers.title_ja: CuraLoc: 計画されたコード検査によるリポジトリレベルの障害箇所特定
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMによるリポジトリレベルの障害箇所特定（Fault Localization）において、反復的なモデル呼び出しを避け、事前の計画段階で検査対象を決定する手法CuraLocを提案する。候補ファイルの記号をコンパクトな記述で表現し、単一の計画決定で開始シンボル・検査関係・編集仮説を同時に選択することで、トークン使用量を大幅に削減する。SWE-Bench Verifiedにおいて、既存手法LocAgentよりFunc@1精度を向上させつつ記録トークン数を90.3%削減し、SWE-bench Liteでも高い精度を達成した。このアプローチは、LLMの推論コスト効率化とエージェント設計の最適化に寄与する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論効率化・エージェント設計・RAG的検索最適化の核心を突く

papers.title: PPO vs. SAC: A Comparative Study for Cooperative Motion Control of Dual-Arm Space Robots
papers.summary: The growing population of orbital debris has intensified interest in active debris removal and on-orbit servicing, for which dual-arm space manipulators offer improved grasping stability and load distribution relative to single-arm systems. However, coordinating two manipulators under inter-arm collision avoidance, orientation alignment, and sensing uncertainty remains challenging. This paper develops a coordinated reinforcement learning framework for cooperative motion planning of a dual-arm space manipulator in a target-reaching task with inter-arm collision-avoidance constraints. A centralized state representation combines joint-space, end-effector, and target-relative information, while a multi-objective reward function promotes target-reaching accuracy, orientation alignment, motion smoothness, synchronized task completion, and collision avoidance. Within this framework, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) are compared as representative on-policy and off-policy algorithms, and the learned policies are further evaluated for generalization to previously unseen target configurations. Across five random seeds, SAC substantially outperforms PPO within the considered fixed-base simulation scenarios: it reaches an 80% success threshold in every seed (median 1.6M environment steps) whereas PPO does not reach it within a 4M-step budget, and it attains a higher mean success rate (78.6% versus 7.4%) with lower position and orientation errors and tighter bimanual synchronization. Both algorithms degrade on unseen boundary targets, but SAC retains most of its performance while PPO's collapses. The results also expose a failure mode of PPO: under the two-phase shaped reward, it tends to converge to a reward-loitering local optimum rather than committing to the precision task. This behavior highlights the sensitivity of on-policy learning to reward shaping.
papers.title_ja: PPOとSACの比較：デュアルアーム宇宙ロボットの協調運動制御における研究
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、軌道上のデブリ除去やサービス作業を想定したデュアルアーム宇宙マニピュレータの協調運動計画において、強化学習アルゴリズムのPPOとSACを比較検討する。中央集権型の状態表現と多目的報酬関数を用いた枠組みの中で、SACはPPOよりも大幅に高い成功率と汎化性能を示した。特に、PPOは報酬整形に対して敏感であり、局所最適解に収束しやすい失敗モードが確認された。この結果は、宇宙ロボットの制御においてオフポリシー手法が有効であることを示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習と宇宙機（マニピュレータ）制御の組み合わせであり、ユーザーの関心に合致

papers.title: The Impact of Orbital Data Centers on the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory
papers.summary: As the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory begins its Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), satellite operators are racing to launch Orbital Data Center (ODC) satellites into low-Earth orbit. We present an impact assessment of a simulated $\sim$1 million ODC satellite constellation, arranged per recent filings across two low-Earth and two Sun-synchronous orbit regimes, on one year of Rubin Observatory LSST observations. Our six-stage sequential pipeline combines orbit propagation, field-of-view matching, observer-frame geometry, brightness modeling, surface-brightness calculations, and pixel-loss estimates. We find that on a given night, up to 80% of LSST pointings would contain at least one illuminated ODC satellite streak, depending on the time of year. The yearly average of contaminated exposures is closer to 20%, due to seasonal visibility variations and bright satellite streaks being most prominent near twilight. Sun-synchronous ODCs disproportionately contaminate due to preferential illumination geometry. The ODC satellite brightness distribution is multi-modal, where solar panel specular reflection can appear as bright as 2-4 AB mag ($\mu_g \approx 9-11$ mag arcsec$^{-2}$), while diffuse reflections more typically reach 6 AB mag ($\mu_g \approx 13-14$ mag arcsec$^{-2}$). Even at 10% deployment, the constellation would still produce widespread visible streak contamination throughout the year. ODC satellites would also drastically increase sky brightness -- by more than 1000% near twilight with no Moon. Launching and operating ODC satellites at this scale would significantly harm LSST science, including typical 5-10% nightly mean pixel losses near twilight, even if multiple mitigation strategies are implemented.
papers.title_ja: 軌道データセンターがNSF-DOEベラ・C・ルービン天文台に与える影響
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道に配置される約100万基の軌道データセンター（ODC）衛星群が、ルービン天文台のLSST観測に与える影響を評価した。軌道伝播、視野マッチング、輝度モデリングなどを含む6段階のパイプラインを用いて、衛星ストリークによる汚染をシミュレーションした。結果、特定の夜には最大80%の観測ポイントに衛星ストリークが含まれ、年間平均でも約20%の露光が汚染される可能性があることが判明した。特に太陽同期軌道衛星は幾何学的要因により汚染が顕著であり、夕暮れ時の空の明るさを1000%以上増加させるなど、科学観測に重大な悪影響を及ぼすことが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と衛星軌道設計の応用、および観測データ処理の文脈で関連性が高い

papers.title: A generalization of Gordon's Theorem to arbitrary winding number
papers.summary: We study minimizers of the Keplerian action functional with homogeneous potential of type $1/|u|^\alpha$ on periodic loops with fixed winding number $k \in \mathbb{Z}\setminus\{0\}$. This extends the classical theorems of Gordon and Venturelli, closing the previously open case $\alpha \in (1,2)$, $|k|\geq 2$. We show that the $k$-circular solution loses local minimality below the threshold $\alpha = 2-1/|k|^2$, and that minimizers are collision-free above $\alpha = 2-1/|k|$. Combining these results with the existence of precessing periodic orbits in between, we obtain a full classification of the minimizer in terms of $\alpha$ and $k$, which we also verify numerically for $k=2$.
papers.title_ja: Gordonの定理の任意の巻き数への一般化
papers.summary_ja: ケプラー作用汎関数の最小化問題を対象とし、固定された巻き数を持つ周期ループにおける解の性質を解析した。GordonおよびVenturelliの古典的定理を拡張し、以前未解決であったα∈(1,2)かつ|k|≥2の場合を閉じた。巻き数kとポテンシャル指数αの閾値に基づき、衝突の有無や局所最小性の喪失を明確にし、中間領域における進動する周期軌道の存在と合わせて最小化解の完全な分類を行った。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・軌道最適化の核となる数学的理論であり、ユーザーの関心に直結する。

papers.title: Graphs of Trajectory Bundles for Nonlinear Motion Planning
papers.summary: We present the Graphs of Trajectory Bundles (GTB) method for motion planning of systems with nonlinear and black-box dynamics, combining sampling-based motion planning with trajectory optimization and graph search. Based on a graph-of-convex-sets decomposition of the workspace, GTB iteratively constructs a graph of trajectory bundles that captures the local dynamics of the system at any vertex. By solving a shortest-path problem on this graph, we find maximally dynamically feasible iterates that satisfy the system's dynamics in the limit and any constraints such as collision avoidance or additional safety or specification constraints by construction of the underlying graph. As a result, GTB can handle highly nonlinear, unstable, and even black-box dynamics with complex collision and specification constraints, making it a powerful tool for motion planning of complex systems.
papers.title_ja: 非線形運動計画のための軌道バンドルグラフ
papers.summary_ja: 非線形かつブラックボックスなダイナミクスを持つシステムの運動計画手法「GTB」を提案する。作業空間の凸集合グラフ分解に基づき、各頂点で局所ダイナミクスを捉える軌道バンドルグラフを反復的に構築する。このグラフ上の最短路問題により、衝突回避や安全性制約を構造的に満たしつつ、動的に実現可能な軌道を効率的に探索する。高次非線形性や不安定性、複雑な制約条件を持つシステムの計画に有効である。
papers.relevance_reason: 非線形軌道計画・最適化の高度な手法であり、軌道設計の関心に直結する

papers.title: StarRTT: An End-to-End Real-Time Framework for Blind Zone-Free RTT Prediction in Starlink LEO Satellite Networks
papers.summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite mega-constellations such as Starlink require frequent handovers due to high orbital velocities, resulting in substantial Round-Trip Time (RTT) fluctuations. Accurate RTT prediction can mitigate these fluctuations, yet it fundamentally relies on continuously updated serving- satellite information. Existing serving-satellite identification methods typically complete identification only at the end of each scheduling cycle, creating an identification blind zone that limits real-time prediction. To overcome this limitation, we develop StarRTT, an end-to-end real-time framework that eliminates the blind zone by integrating per-second serving-satellite identification with RTT prediction. Within this framework, we propose Real-Time Long Short-Term Memory (RT-LSTM), an LSTM-based RTT prediction model designed to capture both non-stationary RTT evolution and time-varying geometric relationships among the serving satellite, user terminal, and gateways. Specifically, a historical LSTM encodes historical RTT observations and real-time serving-satellite and gateway-relative features, while a future LSTM processes Two-Line Element (TLE)-propagated future features of the identified serving satellite up to the next scheduling instant. Under strict real-time back-testing, RT-LSTM achieves a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 1.405 ms averaged over all 15 prediction horizons and 15 reference time-slot indices, reducing the error by 4.3 %, 11.6 %, and 22.1 % compared with the existing baseline models, LSTM, StarNet, and Attention-based Spatiotemporal Model (ASTM), respectively. Notably, the reduction over LSTM reaches 12.5 % at the scheduling instant, highlighting the benefit of real-time serving-satellite information when recent RTT observations are limited.
papers.title_ja: StarRTT: Starlink LEO衛星ネットワークにおける盲域なしRTT予測のためのエンドツーエンドリアルタイムフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: StarlinkなどのLEO衛星コンステレーションにおけるハンドオーバーに伴うRTT変動を低減するため、サービング衛星の識別盲域を解消するリアルタイム予測フレームワークStarRTTを提案する。本手法は、秒単位の衛星識別とRTT予測を統合し、LSTMベースのモデルRT-LSTMを用いて非定常なRTT進化と幾何学的関係性を捉える。TLEによる未来軌道伝播情報を活用することで、既存のLSTMやASTMモデルと比較し、平均絶対誤差（MAE）を最大22.1%低減する高精度な予測を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と機械学習（LSTM）の融合による実務的予測手法

papers.title: Real-to-Sim Calibration of Bosch Etching Simulators with Few-Shot XSEM Data and Hybrid Search
papers.summary: The Bosch process is widely used in MEMS and TSV fabrication, but accurate prediction of etching outcomes remains difficult without calibration against real measurements, which are sparse and costly to obtain. This work presents a few-shot real-to-sim calibration framework that decouples simulator parameters from direct process variables to infer a recipe-specific simulator parameter vector from sparse measurements, enabling reliable prediction of etch depth and sidewall angle under held-out process conditions. We first formulate Bosch profile prediction as a few-shot real-to-sim calibration problem, where a small set of real XSEM measurements is used to identify a recipe-specific ViennaPS parameter vector $z_r^*$ that minimizes the discrepancy between simulated and measured etch depth and sidewall angle. To search this parameter space efficiently, the framework combines local exploration, LLM-guided candidate generation, and XGBoost-based surrogate screening, while retaining ViennaPS simulation as the final verification step for each selected candidate. Experiments on two Bosch etching recipes show that the proposed framework accurately predicts held-out etching results, achieving normalized global errors of 0.340 and 0.249 for the 2 recipes respectively.
papers.title_ja: 少ショットXSEMデータとハイブリッド検索を用いたBoschエッチングシミュレータのReal-to-Simキャリブレーション
papers.summary_ja: MEMSやTSV製造で用いられるBoschプロセスにおいて、希少な実測データを用いたシミュレータの高精度キャリブレーション手法を提案する。LLMによる候補生成、XGBoostベースのサロゲートスクリーニング、および局所探索を組み合わせることで、パラメータ空間の効率的な探索を実現した。最終的にViennaPSシミュレーションで検証するハイブリッドアプローチにより、保持プロセス条件におけるエッチング深さや側壁角度の予測精度を向上させた。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMとサロゲートモデルを組み合わせたハイブリッド最適化手法であり、ユーザーの関心に合致する。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks vs U-Net: Application to thermal dust emission recovery in the microwave
papers.summary: Galactic thermal dust emission is the dominant foreground contaminant of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) at frequencies above 100 GHz, and its accurate separation is essential for current and future CMB experiments. Deep learning methods, in particular convolutional architectures such as the U-Net, have demonstrated strong performance for CMB component separation, but typically operate as purely data-driven models with no explicit enforcement of the physical laws governing the emission they reconstruct. In this work, we present a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) that embeds the Modified Black Body (MBB) spectral model as a hard, differentiable architectural constraint, and we compare it against a standard U-Net baseline trained under an identical pipeline. Both architectures are trained on realistic simulated Planck HFI patches at four frequencies (143, 217, 353 and 545 GHz) and evaluated on a shared validation set as well as on three independent Galactic dust realizations from the PySM phenomenological dust models named D4, D7 and D10. We find that both networks achieve comparable reconstruction quality across all evaluated datasets, with a Structural Similarity Index Measure consistently above 0.96 and a fitted angular power-spectrum spectral index that agrees with the input to within 1% in every region. Embedding the physical constraint in the PINN does not measurably degrade reconstruction accuracy relative to the unconstrained U-Net, while additionally guaranteeing that every predicted output corresponds to a thermodynamically admissible physical configuration. These results establish the physics-informed formulation as a viable methodological alternative for dust component separation, providing physical interpretability without a trade-off in reconstruction fidelity.
papers.title_ja: 物理情報ニューラルネットワークとU-Netの比較：マイクロ波における熱的ダスト放射の復元への応用
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙マイクロ波背景放射（CMB）の成分分離において、物理法則を制約として組み込んだ物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）と、従来のU-Netを比較した。Planck衛星のシミュレーションデータを用いた評価では、両モデルとも高い再構成精度を示し、PINNは精度の劣化なしに熱力学的に許容される物理的設定を保証できることを示した。この手法は、物理的解釈可能性を損なわずにダスト成分分離を行う有効な代替手段として確立された。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットという関心領域の手法を、具体的応用として検証しているため。

papers.title: Cautious Conflict-Free Inverse Gradient Methods
papers.summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) are indispensable tools for modeling complex phenomena in physics and engineering. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful alternative to traditional numerical solvers by directly incorporating physical constraints into neural network loss functions. Despite their advantages, PINN training requires multi-objective optimization, which often leads to significant gradient conflicts among boundary, initial, and residual loss terms. The Conflict-Free Inverse Gradient (ConFIG) method addresses these conflicts; however, integrating ConFIG with adaptive optimizers such as Adam introduces a critical vulnerability: the conflict-free direction generated by ConFIG is further processed by the optimizer, and the resulting weight update may no longer be conflict-free with respect to the task gradients. To address this issue, Cautious ConFIG is proposed as a concise three-line extension to the ConFIG algorithm that empirically restores the conflict-freeness guarantee prior to the weight update. The method is evaluated on three PINN benchmarks: the 1D Viscous Burgers' equation, the 1D Nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation, and the 2D Kovasznay flow. Experimental results demonstrate consistent performance improvements over the standard ConFIG baseline. Additionally, the stabilizing effect of cautious masking and its reaction to conflict severity, task number, and optimizer lag are investigated using a simple toy system.
papers.title_ja: 慎重な競合フリー逆勾配法
papers.summary_ja: 物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）の学習における損失関数間の勾配競合問題を解決する手法を提案する。既存のConFIG法とAdamなどの適応型オプティマイザを組み合わせる際に生じる「競合フリー性の喪失」問題を指摘し、これを解消するCautious ConFIGを提唱する。わずか3行のアルゴリズム拡張により、重み更新前の競合フリー性を保証する。粘性バーガース方程式や非線形シュレーディンガー方程式などのPINNベンチマークで、既存手法を上回る性能と安定性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNと最適化手法の改善であり、物理情報ニューラルネットへの直接適用が可能

papers.title: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) approximations of capillary menisci in polygonal channels
papers.summary: In a zero-gravity cylindrical container, a meniscus can span a square or equilateral-triangular cross-section only at contact angles at or above the respective Concus-Finn critical angles of 45 degrees and 60 degrees. We study strong-form physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) across these thresholds under fixed collocation and optimization budgets. Classical capillary flux balance yields a lower bound on the combined interior and wall residual loss for arbitrary positive sampling densities. In the tested nonexistence regime, several degrees below the critical angles, independently evaluated network losses are 1.6-1.9 times this bound. A polynomial least-squares comparison supports the same geometric interpretation. The PINNs still return smooth graphs with finite axial extent, even though the prescribed equilibrium problem has no spanning graph solution. Their small interior residuals coexist with wall-flux deficits near corners, where adjoining contact-angle conditions demand more flux than a finite-slope graph can supply. Residuals vary on both sides of the critical angle, while the bound tends uniformly to zero at threshold for fixed wall weight. These results give a geometric scale for interpreting the computed loss and locate the incompatibility that a small interior residual can conceal.
papers.title_ja: 多角形チャネルにおける毛細管メンイスの物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）による近似
papers.summary_ja: 無重力環境下の多角形チャネルにおける毛細管現象を、強形式の物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）で解く手法を提案する。臨界接触角付近での損失関数の挙動を解析し、古典的な毛細管フラックス平衡から得られる下限値と比較した。非存在領域でもPINNは滑らかなグラフを返すが、コーナー付近の壁面フラックス不足という幾何学的な不整合を隠蔽していることを示した。この研究は、計算損失の解釈における幾何学的なスケールを提供し、小さな内部残差が隠蔽する不整合を特定する手法を確立する。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNというユーザー関心領域の手法を物理問題に適用し、精度と限界を解析しているため。

papers.title: Sensitivity-Guided Parameter Estimation of Bubbly Liquid via a Nonlinear Wave Equation and Physics-InformedNeuralNetworks
papers.summary: Interactions between ultrasound and microbubbles underlie a range of biomedical and industrial applications, yet predicting how the physical parameters of the medium and bubbles govern nonlinear wave propagation remains difficult. This study proposes a parameter estimation framework that combines a Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers (KdVB) equation, describing weakly nonlinear wave propagation in a bubbly liquid, with a physics-informed neural network (PINN). The contributions are threefold. First, the PINN reproduces the reference solution of the governing equation in the forward problem, with a near-zero prediction error at the initial time that confirms the initial condition is enforced exactly as intended. Second, prior to inverse estimation, a sensitivity analysis is introduced that quantifies, at both the coefficient and solution levels, how each of eight physical parameters influences the KdVB equation, allowing the expected difficulty of estimating each parameter to be assessed in advance. Third, based on this assessment, single-parameter inverse estimation is performed for seven of the eight parameters using the PINN. Liquid viscosity, bubble initial radius, liquid density, sound speed, and liquid pressure are estimated with errors of 0.8-2.1%, the polytropic exponent converges only partially, and the surface tension coefficient cannot be estimated at all, consistent with the sensitivity analysis. These results establish a general framework for identifying and estimating the physical parameters governing nonlinear wave propagation in bubbly liquids from observed waveform data.
papers.title_ja: 非線形波方程式と物理情報ニューラルネットワークを用いた気泡入り液体の感度ガイド型パラメータ推定
papers.summary_ja: 気泡入り液体における非線形波伝播を記述するKdVB方程式と物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を組み合わせ、物理パラメータの推定フレームワークを提案した。感度分析により各パラメータの影響度を事前に評価し、その結果に基づいて単一パラメータ逆問題の推定を行った。液体粘度や音速などの主要パラメータは0.8〜2.1%の誤差で高精度に推定可能であった一方、表面張力係数は感度が低く推定不能であった。この手法は、観測波形データから物理パラメータを同定する汎用的なアプローチとして有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNと物理方程式の融合、感度分析による最適化支援という関心領域と高度に一致

papers.title: Physics Informed Neural Network for Multi-dimensional Turbulent Self-gravitating Flows
papers.summary: Molecular clouds exhibit complex, multi-scale dynamics driven by the interplay of turbulence, self-gravity, and gas pressure. Modelling these systems with conventional grid-based methods becomes increasingly expensive as spatial resolution and dimensionality increase. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free alternative by incorporating the governing equations directly into the training objective, but their ability to model realistic turbulent self-gravitating flows remains largely unexplored. We apply PINNs to isothermal molecular clouds initialized with astrophysically motivated turbulent velocity fields, considering subsonic and supersonic evolution in two and three dimensions. We benchmark the predicted density and velocity fields against the finite-volume code Athena++. PINNs accurately recover the global evolution of the flow over multiple free-fall times across turbulent realizations, Mach numbers, and dimensionalities. Their training cost also exhibits weak dependence on spatial resolution, increasing by less than 25% from 128^3 to 1024^3 in our experiments. These results demonstrate that PINNs can model substantially more realistic self-gravitating turbulent flows than previously explored and provide a promising complementary framework for studying these systems.
papers.title_ja: 多次元乱流自己重力流のための物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 分子雲の複雑な乱流と自己重力の相互作用を、従来の格子法に代わるメッシュフリー手法として物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）でモデル化する研究である。等温分子雲の亜音速・超音速進化を2次元・3次元で扱い、有限体積法コードAthena++との比較を通じて精度を検証した。結果、PINNは複数の自由落下時間にわたり流れの全体的な進化を正確に再現し、空間解像度に対する学習コストの依存性が弱い（128^3から1024^3へ増加しても25%未満）ことが示された。これにより、より現実的な自己重力乱流流を効率的にモデル化できる有望な補完的枠組みが提供される。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNという関心領域の手法を、高コストな物理シミュレーションの高速化・サロゲート化に応用しているため。

papers.title: A domain-decomposition reduced-order model for two-phase CO$_2$ sequestration with moving wells
papers.summary: We present a domain-decomposition reduced-order model for two-phase geological CO$_2$ storage with fixed and moving wells. The approach builds on a nonoverlapping Schur formulation of a conservative RT0--P0 discretization solved by a sequential pressure--transport algorithm. The distinctive feature of the formulation is that local reduced models are coupled through physically meaningful interface variables: pressure traces for the pressure solve and inflow saturation traces for the transport solve. To address moving wells, we introduce a well-aware strategy that combines source-response enrichment, HAPOD-based far-field compression, and hybrid full-order/reduced-order treatment of well and near-well subdomains. We also formulate conservation-oriented hyper-reduction rules where interface fluxes, boundary terms and source terms are protected. Numerical results are presented to demonstrate accuracy, computational efficiency, robustness of the overall methodology.
papers.title_ja: 移動井戸を伴う二相CO2地中封入のための領域分割縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 二相CO2地中封入問題に対し、非重複Schur形式と逐次圧力・輸送アルゴリズムに基づく領域分割縮約モデルを提案する。移動井戸への対応として、ソース応答補強やHAPODベースの遠場圧縮、および井戸近傍のハイブリッド処理を導入した。さらに、界面フラックスや境界項を保護する保存則指向のハイパーリダクションルールを定式化し、精度と計算効率の両立を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと物理情報的手法の組み合わせであり、ユーザーの関心領域に該当する。

papers.title: Regret-Based Scenario-Tree Construction for Multistage Stochastic Programs with Deterministic Constraints
papers.summary: Scenario trees are widely used to discretize multistage stochastic programs into forms that are tractable for numerical optimization. Yet, traditional scenario-tree construction methods are typically based on statistical similarity between the original uncertainty process and its discretization, and may fail to preserve the aspects of the uncertainty that matter most for decision-making. This paper shows that, under a fixed probability measure and deterministic feasibility constraints, the gap between the optimal value of the original multistage stochastic program and that of its scenario-tree approximation decomposes exactly into a sum of nodewise regret terms, each measuring the optimality loss at a particular node. This decomposition provides a clear target for scenario-tree construction: minimizing total regret across the tree. Motivated by this result, we propose a practical two-phase construction method for repeated stochastic optimization. In an offline phase, computationally inexpensive surrogates for decision regret are learned from data, and in the online phase, these surrogates guide scenario-tree construction. The resulting framework retains the structured optimization and constraint-handling capabilities of multistage stochastic programming while exploiting learned information about the uncertainty to make more effective use of a limited scenario-tree budget. Numerical experiments on multistage stochastic storage and production-planning problems show that, for a fixed tree size, the proposed method constructs higher-quality scenario trees and achieves better closed-loop performance than traditional scenario-tree construction methods.
papers.title_ja: 決定論的制約付き多段確率計画における後悔ベースのシナリオツリー構築
papers.summary_ja: 多段確率計画において、シナリオツリーの近似誤差をノードごとの「後悔（regret）」の和として厳密に分解する理論的枠組みを提示する。この分解に基づき、オフラインフェーズで決定後悔のサロゲートモデルを学習し、オンラインフェーズでそれを活用してシナリオツリーを構築する2段階手法を提案する。本手法は、限られた計算予算内でより高品質なシナリオツリーを生成し、ストレージや生産計画などの数値実験で従来の統計的類似性ベースの手法を上回るクローズドループ性能を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと最適化の組み合わせが関心に直結

papers.title: When does boundary-condition uncertainty outweigh thermal and vegetation effects in street canyon flow? A global sensitivity analysis of input uncertainty
papers.summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is increasingly used to resolve wind, heat, and pollution patterns in cities with high fidelity but high computational cost. Thermal effects and vegetation are often neglected despite being important drivers, yet their influence may be masked by variability from other uncertain inputs. This work determines how precisely model parameters and boundary conditions must be known for these effects to govern output uncertainty in the velocity, temperature, and concentration fields of a two-dimensional street canyon. A global Sobol analysis of 24 parameters is made tractable by a surrogate trained on Reynolds-Averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) simulations, combining principal component analysis (PCA) with multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Two ventilation regimes assess the variance due to thermal and vegetation parameters as uncertainty in all other inputs is progressively reduced. At typical uncertainty levels, turbulence closure constants and inflow turbulence profiles govern variability in all three fields in both regimes. Under weak ventilation, solar forcing becomes the main source of temperature variability once the remaining uncertainties are halved, and of concentration variance once they are reduced to a quarter (about $\pm11\%$ for the dominant closure constant and $\pm12\%$ for the emission rate). In contrast, vegetation contributes significantly at typical uncertainty levels. Under strong ventilation, however, the canopy never overtakes the closure constants, even when the dominant one is known to $\pm5\%$. Spatially, both effects peak at road level and along canyon walls, which influence outdoor exposure and indoor infiltration, suggesting that high-resolution exposure studies should account for them.
papers.title_ja: 街路峡谷流において境界条件の不確実性が熱効果や植生効果を上回る条件は何か？入力不確実性のグローバル感度分析
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、2次元街路峡谷のCFDシミュレーション結果を用いて、熱効果や植生が出力不確実性に与える影響をグローバル感度分析（Sobol法）で評価した。RANSシミュレーションデータから訓練したPCAと多層パーセプトロン（MLP）を組み合わせたサロゲートモデルにより、24パラメータの計算コストを低減し効率的な分析を実現した。結果、典型的な不確実性レベルでは乱流閉鎖定数や流入乱流プロファイルが支配的であるが、不確実性を低減すると弱通風下では太陽放射が、強通風下では植生が重要な要因として浮上することが示された。この手法は、高コストなCFD計算をサロゲートモデルで代替し、物理現象の主要因を特定する実用的なアプローチを提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとMLPを用いた感度分析が関心に合致

papers.title: When and How Does Muon Precondition? The Role of Structured Gradient Noise
papers.summary: Muon has become a popular optimizer for large language model training, yet its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we study how gradient noise geometry shapes Muon's preconditioning benefits. We first show, theoretically and empirically, that under the classical isotropic noise assumption, Muon offers no acceleration beyond a rescaling of the learning rate. This motivates us to investigate structured noise arising from mini-batch sampling in associative memory with heterogeneous task frequencies. We establish an exact balancing threshold for two tasks and extend the analysis to multiple tasks, revealing how task coverage and gradient reliability jointly shape learning. Our analysis shows that Muon can soften the dependence on task frequency from linear to square-root, helping balance the learning of frequent and rare tasks. We further identify rotation-induced negative transfer in SignSGD that Muon avoids, and explain how momentum reduces sampling noise while tracking changing gradients. Controlled numerical experiments validate these mechanisms, and a preliminary LLM pretraining study illustrates the practical promise of fast-slow momentum.
papers.title_ja: Muonはいつどのように事前条件付けを行うのか？構造化勾配ノイズの役割
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）学習で人気のあるオプティマイザー「Muon」の理論的基礎を、勾配ノイズの幾何学的構造という観点から分析した研究である。古典的な等方性ノイズ仮定ではMuonは学習率の再スケーリング以上の加速効果を持たないことを示した上で、ミニバッチサンプリングによる構造化ノイズ下での挙動を理論的に解明した。特に、タスク頻度の異質性がある環境において、Muonが頻出タスクと希少タスクの学習バランスを改善し、頻度への依存性を線形から平方根に緩和するメカニズムを定式化した。さらに、SignSGDに見られる回転誘発の負転移をMuonが回避する理由や、モーメンタムによるノイズ低減効果を説明し、LLM事前学習での実用性を示唆している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化と深層学習手法の両方に直結する重要なオプティマイザー研究

papers.title: Learning to Be Monitored: Causal Bounds and Intervention-Aware Post-Training Recipes for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
papers.summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring aims to detect potentially harmful behaviors in large language models (LLMs) from their CoTs. Intervention-based evaluations measure this property by asking whether a monitor can detect the role of an intervention from the CoT when the targeted behavior occurs, typically using minimal-criterion sensitivity ($\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$) proposed by~\citep{guan2025monitoring}. However, a target behavior observed under intervention is not necessarily caused by it, and we show that this metric can overestimate how often a monitor detects target behaviors actually caused by the intervention. Specifically, we establish $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ as an upper bound on this causal detection rate and derive a complementary lower bound, which provides a tighter evaluation framework for CoT monitorability. With this framework, we study whether LLMs can be trained to make their CoTs easier to monitor. We first construct a training dataset of paired control--intervention tasks spanning multiple intervention types. Using the dataset, we design and apply three intervention-specific training methods based on off-policy self-distillation, reinforcement learning, and on-policy self-distillation to train separate variants of each base model. Across various model-monitor configurations, all three methods generally improve CoT monitorability over the corresponding base models under our extended evaluation framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/xinyue-lxy/learning-to-be-monitored.
papers.title_ja: 監視されることを学ぶ：思考連鎖の監視可能性に向けた因果的境界と介入対応型ポストトレーニング手法
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の思考連鎖（CoT）における有害行動の検出精度を、従来の指標が過大評価する問題を指摘し、因果的な検出率の上下限を導出する新しい評価枠組みを提案する。この枠組みを用い、オフポリシー自己蒸留、強化学習、オンポリシー自己蒸留の3つの介入特異な学習手法を設計・適用した。実験の結果、これら3手法はいずれもベースモデルと比較してCoTの監視可能性を向上させることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論透明性・評価手法・強化学習による制御が関心に直結

papers.title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
papers.summary: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query. We formulate the problem as an accuracy-cost optimization problem and develop a cost-sensitive learning approach for modality selection. We evaluate our approach on WorldSense using Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni under three inference-cost measures: input tokens, latency, and monetary cost. Across both models, query-wise modality selection consistently improves the accuracy-cost trade-off and can even outperform the standard setting in which all available modalities are provided to the Omni-LLM. For Qwen2.5-Omni, our cost-sensitive approach matches or exceeds this full-modality accuracy while requiring only approximately 41% of the input tokens, 39% of the latency, and 61% of the monetary cost.
papers.title_ja: クエリごとのモーダル選択による効率的なオムニモーダル大規模言語モデル推論
papers.summary_ja: オムニモーダルLLMの推論コスト削減を目的とし、クエリごとに最適なモーダル（テキスト・音声・動画など）を動的に選択する手法を提案する。精度とコストの最適化問題として定式化し、コスト感度学習アプローチを開発した。Qwen2.5-Omni等のモデルを用いた評価では、全モーダル提供時と同等以上の精度を維持しつつ、入力トークン数を約41%、レイテンシを39%、コストを61%に削減できることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の効率化・コスト最適化に直結する手法であり、ユーザーの関心と高い一致度がある。

papers.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
papers.summary: Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window. To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction. Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions. Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks. Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories. We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench). For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench. No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving other models the same. Compaction can, however, silently remove task constraints: on ProgramBench, the first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average, and this rises monotonically with the number of compactions. On real user-agent sessions from SWE-chat, instructions about how the agent should work and what it should not do are dropped around 6 times more than specifications of what to build. We argue that current benchmarks are compaction-friendly: i.e., the objective is fixed and the agent's progress stays on disk, so most of what compaction discards can be recovered, except constraints that don't exist anywhere else.
papers.title_ja: ベンチマークは驚くほどコンパクション（文脈圧縮）に耐性がある
papers.summary_ja: 長期的なエージェントタスクにおけるLLMのコンテキストウィンドウ管理手法「コンパクション」を、フロンティアモデルと現実的なベンチマークを用いて体系的に評価した。1Mトークン対応モデルではコンパクション閾値が性能に与える影響は測定不能なほど小さかったが、コンテキストが小さいモデルではタスク制約の喪失により性能低下が見られた。特に、コンパクションによりアンチチートルールや行動規範などの重要な制約が静かに削除されるリスクが示された。既存のベンチマークは成果物がディスク上に保存されるためコンパクションに耐性があるが、制約条件の保持には注意が必要である。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法の両方に直結する重要な知見

papers.title: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
papers.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers, the standard backbone for modern large-scale deep learning, employ conditional computation: only a sparse subset of model weights is used in each forward pass. In MoE transformers, this sparsity arises in the MoE operator, which generalizes the multi-layer perceptron in the classical transformer. In this work, we explore an alternative mechanism for conditional computation that analogously generalizes the attention operator. The sparsity induced by this mechanism naturally nests (i.e., hierarchically composes) with the sparsity induced by the MoE operator. We show that a transformer employing this nested sparsity mechanism, which we call Nestor, performs better than a conventional MoE transformer at equal compute and equal sparsity in language model pretraining. We also show that Nestor is well-suited for continual pretraining: it can be adapted to longer contexts more effectively than conventional MoEs, as well as adapt more efficiently to new domains while forgetting less on old domains. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these benefits persist as model size, dataset size, and context length grow. Our results demonstrate the potential of alternative conditional computation mechanisms for deep neural network architectures. Code and checkpoints are available on GitHub at https://github.com/Ma-Lab-Berkeley/Nestor .
papers.title_ja: スケーラブルな事前学習と継続学習のためのネストスパース性
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、MoEトランスフォーマーの条件付き計算メカニズムを拡張し、アテンション演算子にスパース性を導入する新アーキテクチャ「Nestor」を提案する。このネストスパース性はMoEのスパース性と階層的に組み合わせられ、同等の計算量・スパース性において従来のMoEを上回る事前学習性能を示す。さらに、継続学習においてコンテキスト長の拡張や新ドメインへの適応が効率的であり、旧ドメインの忘却も少ないことを実証した。モデル規模やデータセットサイズが拡大してもこれらの利点は維持されることが確認された。

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
papers.summary: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.
papers.title_ja: 人間フィードバックによる大規模言語モデルの整列：数学的基礎とアルゴリズム設計
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）を人間の意向や価値観に整列させるための数学的基礎とアルゴリズムフレームワークを解説するチュートリアルである。SFT、RLHF、DPOなどの標準的な手法に加え、逆強化学習（IRL）や離散選択モデルとの理論的関連性を考察している。最新アルゴリズムの利点・限界を実装視点から整理し、より堅牢でスケーラブルな整列技術の開発に向けた包括的なリソースを提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの整列手法と強化学習の理論的基礎を扱い、ユーザーの関心に直結する。

papers.title: Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models
papers.summary: Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff's delta up to 0.867 beyond the budget). Both results follow if agreement, and not the normalisation itself, is what keeps depth reusable. The damage sits in the readout together with the last layer of the block: in the models trained from scratch, refitting the head over the frozen modified loop recovers a third of the lost accuracy and plateaus, while refitting the last block layer with it recovers all of it. Finally, comparing looped with stacked depth at an equal inference loop count is confounded by unequal overshoot of the trained budget; at matched overshoot the advantage of looping vanishes on one task and shrinks on the other.
papers.title_ja: ループ型言語モデルにおいて、正規化ではなく整合性が深さの再利用性を維持する
papers.summary_ja: ループ型言語モデルでは、推論時の深さ再利用性を支える要因が層間正規化ではなく、学習時と推論時のループ構造の整合性であることが示された。既存モデルから正規化を除去すると精度が崩壊するが、これは状態ノームの爆発ではなく、読み出し層と最終層の不一致が原因である。新規学習実験では、正規化なしの方が推論時の外挿性能が優れる場合があり、両者の差異は学習済み深さ付近で最小となる。また、ループ型とスタック型の比較において、学習予算超過量の不一致が性能差を歪めている可能性が指摘された。

papers.title: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
papers.summary: This report introduces Kolibri, an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence. We built Kolibri for sovereign and specialised deployment, with a particular focus on German and on regulated domains such as public administration, industry, and aerospace. To support these settings, we control the full model-development process, including data, architecture, training infrastructure, post-training, and evaluation. We train Kolibri on 24T tokens across pre-training, mid-training, and long-context extension, with German accounting for more than 20% of the data mix by bytes. To reach this share, we complement German datasets with more than 2T German tokens that we curate from the web with our own pipeline and generate synthetically. Post-training combines supervised fine-tuning on curated German and English data with reinforcement learning on more than 1.2M internally curated tasks, which cover reasoning, tool use, instruction following, code, and retrieval. The model activates 4.4% of its parameters per token, and among the open models evaluated in this report, it lies on the Pareto frontier of quality and serving cost in English and German. Kolibri builds on Kolibri Origin, an earlier iteration that validated our full pipeline at scale. Both models come from our Model Factory, which connects data, experimentation, training, evaluation, and deployment through version-controlled workflows.
papers.title_ja: Kolibri: パレートフロンティア上の欧州主権モデル
papers.summary_ja: 欧州の主権と規制対象分野（航空宇宙含む）向けに設計された、英語・ドイツ語対応のMoEトランスフォーマーモデル「Kolibri」を紹介する。総パラメータ78.1Bに対しアクティブパラメータは3.46Bと低く、推論コスト効率に優れている。強化学習やツール使用を含む多様なタスクで後学習を行い、品質とサービングコストのバランスにおいてオープンモデルの中でパレートフロンティア上に位置する。

papers.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
papers.summary: Conventional neural-network training typically follows a predefined optimization recipe, motivating a LLM agent that monitors training dynamics and adjusts optimizer settings as training progresses, but a fixed agent policy does not accumulate experience across runs. We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. RSI-Opt substantially improves optimizer-agent performance, with representative raw-space summary $z$-scores increasing from $+10.48$ to $+14.33$ on the evolution suite with Opus 5.5 and from $-0.36$ to $+3.11$ on held-out tasks with GPT-5.5 through cross-model policy transfer. On the Burgers PDE, it reduces mean relative $L_2$ error by approximately 2.7-fold with Opus 5.5 and 8.8-fold with GPT-6.1 over the fixed-prompt agent baseline, although PDE transfer varies across LLMs and tasks. Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks. These findings demonstrate how procedures and executable tools accumulated across training runs can improve optimizer-agent performance and support transfer to scientific machine learning.
papers.title_ja: モデル学習のための再帰的自己改善型オプティマイザエージェント
papers.summary_ja: 本研究は、LLMエージェントが学習ダイナミクスを監視しオプティマイザ設定を動的に調整する枠組み「RSI-Opt」を提案する。従来の固定ポリシーとは異なり、メタエージェントが過去の実行証拠に基づいてプロンプトや手順書、コードライブラリを再帰的に書き換え、知識を蓄積・進化させる。5世代にわたる実験により、既知タスクでは初期決定で大部分の性能向上を実現し、未知タスクでは適応を通じて性能を維持・向上させることが示された。特にBurgers PDEにおいて、固定プロンプトベースラインと比較して平均相対L2誤差を最大8.8倍低減し、科学機械学習への転移可能性も検証されている。
